repairs.question_title: What boundary could help protect my everyday balance?
repairs.problem_sentence: When a new request arrives, name the work already using your time and ask which responsibility should move before you agree.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 5개 프로필에 같은 일반 조언이 반복됐고, 개인의 업무 역할과 사생활에서 필요한 점이 답에 드러나지 않았습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Build the boundary from the profile's calculated work-role wording and private-life need. Do not reuse the generic balance-week action.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: A useful boundary is to protect [profile-specific need] by deciding which work request can wait. Your chart centres on [profile-specific work pattern]; repeated requests can compete with that focus and your personal time.

repairs.question_title: How do my personality, career, money and love connect?
repairs.problem_sentence: The former lead linked work, money and relationships but omitted the personality theme.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 질문에 적힌 네 영역 중 성격이 실제 결론에서 빠져 있었습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Name the personal style, career theme, chart-supported earning route, and separate close-relationship need in the direct answer.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: Your personal style centres on [profile-specific focus]. At work, your chart points to [work theme]; [income route]. These areas meet through the time and effort you can give, while your close relationships have a separate need: [private need]. The chart describes connected themes, not a guaranteed cause or outcome.

repairs.question_title: Which years are most important for me?
repairs.problem_sentence: The lead said no specific year could be named even when a checked timing comparison appeared in its detail.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 연도 정규식이 연주 표기 (간지)를 포함한 제목을 읽지 못해, 답변 첫 문장과 실제 근거가 서로 모순됐습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Read the year and concise theme from verified turning-point comparisons. State no year only when those comparisons contain none.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: The chart flags 2026 (recognised responsibility and clear standards); 2031 (independent judgement); 2032 (ideas, expression and improving a method) as review years. These comparisons identify themes, not guaranteed life events.

repairs.question_title: What should I prioritise over the next three years?
repairs.problem_sentence: The former answer used a stock six-month check and did not derive its priority from the selected chart theme.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 실제 개인별 연간 업무 주제가 답에 연결되지 않았습니다. 또한 계산하지 않은 3개년 예측은 만들면 안 됩니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Derive one useful focus from the current annual chart chapter; disclose that this is a priority, not a year-by-year forecast.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: For the next three years, prioritise [profile-specific annual work theme]. The annual chart comparison identifies this as a useful focus; it does not provide a separate forecast for each of the three years.

repairs.question_title: What should I focus on most this year?
repairs.problem_sentence: Look for work where you can use management, regulated work, public service and structured organisations with enough time and authority to do it well. Before accepting extra duties, agree who makes decisions and what result you own.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 연간 업무 주제는 개인별 계산에서 나오지만 답이 긴 직무 목록과 공통 조언에 치우쳐 그 해의 특징을 바로 보여주지 못했습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Lead with the chart-selected annual work theme, say whether it repeats a familiar demand or adds a different demand when the calculation says so, then give one short responsibility check.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: This year, focus on [calculated annual work theme]. It [repeats a familiar demand / adds a different demand to your usual pattern]. Take on extra responsibility only when you have the time and authority to deliver the result.

repairs.question_title: What should I be careful about in business?
repairs.problem_sentence: Check that your cash and capacity can cover added business demands in [calculated years]. The chart flags planning pressure in those years, not business failure.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 연도는 표시했지만 구체적으로 어떤 사업 운영 항목을 점검해야 하는지와 연도별 계산 주제가 답에서 분명하지 않았습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: Name cash, delivery capacity and responsibility in the direct answer. Summarise each verified year theme and tailor the check to a calculated clash or adjustment; do not imply failure.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: Review cash, delivery capacity and responsibility before taking on more business commitments in [calculated years]. The chart flags planning pressure in those years, not business failure.

repairs.question_title: How do emotional closeness and everyday compatibility differ?
repairs.problem_sentence: Neither chart comparison shows a clear link or clash, so your everyday habits offer the clearest comparison.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 감정 연결과 일상 루틴 모두 뚜렷한 신호가 없는 경우, 기존 첫 문장이 같은 무신호를 반복하면서 질문의 비교 결론을 흐렸습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: State once that emotional connection is not clearly indicated and identify everyday routines as the clearer comparison; then give both partners' chart-specific routines.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: The charts show no clear emotional link or clash; your daily routines offer the clearer comparison.

repairs.question_title: What is the most important insight for my future?
repairs.problem_sentence: Your work pattern—customer growth and business development—shares a chart area with clues for steady pay and income from customers or projects. This links work and earning themes, but does not estimate your pay.
repairs.deduction_reason_ko: 가운데 삽입된 대시 때문에 PDF 텍스트 추출에서 문장이 어색하게 붙고, 사주 용어처럼 읽힐 수 있는 표현이 질문의 핵심을 흐렸습니다.
repairs.revision_rule: State the calculated link between the work theme and possible earning routes in plain English. Keep the pay limitation concise.
repairs.sample_revised_answer: Your chart links [work theme] at work with [calculated earning routes] as possible ways of earning. That connects the themes, but it cannot estimate your pay.
